amendments.reason: Three contract details the repo could not honor as written. (a) Test path: this repo keeps dashboard unit tests under packages/dashboard/test/<layer>/, not src-colocated - same deviation phase 1 hit. (b) The FlagEditFailure -> failure-outcome mapping (10 cases) and describeEdit were private to edit-feature.ts; duplicating them would have been a 10-arm and a 9-arm copy, so both are now exported and editFailure's return type is narrowed to the failure variant. EXECUTE 2026-09-21: Changed by this phase: packages/dashboard/e2e/pending-changes-drift.spec.ts (new; the only file, no src/ or fixture edits). Two tests. Both stage an edit by ticking Enabled on dark-mode and clicking Save enabled in the real form, assert the auto-opened Review Dialog lists dark-mode, close it, move the version with env.publishAs(bob) and assert env.currentVersion is 2, then re-render through the Filter GET form (which carries the hidden draft) and open the Review Dialog trigger. Test 1 asserts the drift warning and an enabled Publish anyway, clicks it, and asserts version == before+1, the trigger gone, and dark-mode enabled in the published features. Test 2 asserts the warning, clicks Discard, and asserts version == before, the Discarded notice, the trigger gone, and dark-mode still off. Locators are role/text based; no waits, retries, timeouts, rollback or segment helpers. Contract note for VERIFY: the Update control is swapped for Publish anyway on drift (review-dialog.ts), so the enabled assertion is on Publish anyway, as the rubric criterion names.
